Umnini wesitolo esincane wabhala inani lamaflaya asabalalisiwe kuleli sonto nokuthengiswa kwalolo suku.

Lesi sitolo sisendaweni eyaziwa ngamakhasimende amaningi ezimpelasonto, futhi umnini wasabalalisa amaflaya amaningi ukuze ahambisane nempelasonto.

y-m-76-08.material:
Ibhokisi elilodwa efektri yezingxenye liqukethe izingxenye ezingu-5,000. Umhloli athathe ngokungahleliwe ezingu-50 ebhokisini wazihlola, futhi okungu-1 kwakunephutha (isilinganiso sephutha sesampula 2%). Umphathi ubike, 'Leli bhokisi linezingxenye ezingu-100 ezinephutha.' Ithebula elingezansi likhombisa 'ithuba lokuthi okungu-1 noma ngaphansi okunephutha kuphume uma kuthathwa abangu-50 ngokungahleliwe, ucabanga ukuthi izinga langempela lamaphutha ebhokisini lonke linje' (amanani abaliwe kusengaphambili).
Izinga lamaphutha 1%: cishe 91.1%, 2%: cishe 73.6%, 5%: cishe 27.9%, 8%: cishe 8.3%, 12%: cishe 1.3%.

y-m-76-01.goal: Qonda ukuthi ngisho no-10% ofanayo unika inani elihlukile kuye ngenani lesisekelo, futhi uthole futhi ulungise umugqa ophosa kunothi lokubala lokuthola i-VAT nentengo ngaphambi kwe-VAT kusuka esambeni esifaka i-VAT.
y-m-76-01.material: Intengo yento ethengiswa esitolo "yisamba sentengo ngaphambi kwe-VAT (inani ngaphambi kokuba i-VAT yengezwe) kanye no-10% we-VAT", futhi i-VAT ingu-10% wentengo ngaphambi kwe-VAT. I-receipt ibonisa kuphela isamba esingu-33,000 won, ngakho isisebenzi sabhala inothi elingezansi ukuthola i-VAT nentengo ngaphambi kwe-VAT. Ungazungezisi, futhi ungacabangi ngamanye amaxhoso noma izindleko. (Izinombolo zemigqa ziqala ku-1.)

y-m-76-01.s.s1.line.4: Ezinye izinhlamvu zokuthenga nazo, ukukhipha u-10% esambeni kunikeza intengo engaphambi kwe-VAT, ngakho singabala ngendlela efanayo.

y-m-76-09.topic: Ithuba elinombandela: ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-alamu nephutha
y-m-76-09.goal: Hlola ngokubala ukuthi 'uma unephutha, i-alamu iyashaya' no-'i-alamu ishayile, ngakho unephutha' yizitatimende ezihlukile, bese ubala wena ukuthi inani lishintsha kanjani uma izinga lamaphutha lishintsha.
y-m-76-09.material: Umshini wokuhlola wefektri ushaya i-alamu ngethuba elingu-90% uma umkhiqizo unephutha, futhi noma umkhiqizo ojwayelekile ushaya i-alamu ngethuba elingu-5% (i-alamu yamanga). Ngaphandle kwale alamu, akukho ndlela yokwazi ukuthi umkhiqizo unephutha yini. Izinga lamaphutha (isabelo sezinto ezinephutha phakathi kwayo yonke imikhiqizo) lingahluka emugqeni nomugqa.
